judge.summary: The provided index.html only defines the static layout and placeholders for UI elements. All essential interactive features—grid population, word selection, group validation, mistake counting, shuffle, feedback, and daily puzzle generation—are absent or hidden behind ellipsis placeholders. Consequently, the submission does not meet the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to be executable as a functional puzzle game.
